title: Arrivals
text: Morning staff unlock the front door at 08:45. Use the side entrance before opening. Hang the open sign at 09:00.

title: Service appointments
text: Book repairs in 30-minute slots. Ask the rider to bring the bicycle and the service ticket. A walk-in repair gets the next open slot.

title: Receipts and payments
text: A receipt copy needs an invoice reference. A cash sale gets a printed receipt. Send electronic receipts only through the shop register.

title: Loan bicycles
text: The shop has two loan bicycles. A rider signs the loan form before collecting one. A loan bicycle is due back by 17:00 the same day.

title: Storage
text: Put completed repairs on the green rack. Park bicycles awaiting inspection on the orange rack. Return floor pumps to the wall hooks after use.

title: Workshop safety
text: Keep the workbench clear of bags. Wear safety glasses when cutting a cable. Place used blades in the marked container.

title: Work orders
text: A work order names the requested service and parts. Ask for approval before adding any paid service. Record completed work in the service ticket.

title: Stock requests
text: Order common tubes from the weekly stock list. Write a note when the last brake cable is used. The stock count runs on Friday afternoon.

title: Returns
text: Unopened accessories may be returned within 14 days with a receipt. Installed parts go through a service review. The shift lead records each approved return.

title: Closing
text: Check the rear door latch before leaving. Count the till with the shift lead. Turn off the workbench lamps and set the alarm.
